title: Notion Page Edit Weekly Edit Duration Trend
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=notion:page edit_min=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(edit_min) as avg_duration, max(edit_min) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst edit duration for Notion page edit events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture edit_min on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average edit duration with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It scores whether Notion page edit tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
